cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've decided your 'take care' message begins the breakup. That's how my last one started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I explain? You said you had a cold.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Explanation permitted. My ex also wanted me healthy before leaving. You may proceed to the next kindness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I just bring you soup tonight?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Soup is authorized as the farewell meal. Bring a container you don't need back; I won't permit you to prolong the ending with crockery.

reason: Make A grant explanations and care only as approved stages of the feared breakup, using the soup to specify the ending.
